useCase: Identificacion de camara y verificacion IA
mechanism: Utiliza a deep red neuronal (DnCNN) to extract the noise residual of an image, que contains the camera-specific patrón de ruido. Authentic photos have consistent noise signatures from the imaging sensor, while generado por IA images show synthetic or absent patrón de ruidos.
accuracy: Alta - 87-95% for distinguishing camera images from generado por IA content
name: Analisis de huella de ruido
algorithm: Extraccion de ruido basada en DnCNN
parameters: Network: DnCNN-17 layers, Patch size: 64x64, Stride: 32, Correlation metric: normalized cross-correlación
description: Extrae and analiza the camera sensor patrón de ruido (noiseprint) embedded en imágenes. generado por IA images lack authentic sensor noise signatures.

references.title: Cozzolino, D. & Verdoliva, L. (2020). Noiseprint: A CNN-Based Camera Model Fingerprint. IEEE TIFS.
Mandelli, S. et al. (2020). CNN-Based Fast Source Device Identification. IEEE SPL.

strengths:
• Very high precisión for camera vs AI distinction
• Captures camera-specific noise fingerprint
• Deep learning enhances noise extraction
• Robust to moderate post-processing
limitations:
• Requires trained DnCNN model
• Heavy denoising destroys patrón de ruidos
• Social media compression degrades precisión
• New camera models may not be in training data
